search_window.basis: Bounded check since the most recent heartbeat, whose completed_at and zero findings were confirmed via GitHub authenticated branch readback. Retrospective reports were screened for missed developments, but prior-day incidents and previously recorded events were excluded.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall watch only. Primary Gaza collector and publisher remain authoritative and unchanged.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Checked OCHA OPT and WHO first; then 12 additional targeted searches, primary/official humanitarian and established reporting preferred.

official_first_checks.detail: Directly checked November 20 updates index and Humanitarian Situation Report | 18 November 2026 (publication Nov 20, events principally Nov 10–16). No new within-window operational change identified.
Current WHO emergency overview checked; no newly dated health-function, fuel, ambulance or medical-evacuation development in the window.
Direct regional source timed out, as on prior hourly watches; no new material degradation. WHO global was accessible.

source_observations.note: Nov 20 dated publication details 10–16 Nov casualties, healthcare and medevacs, humanitarian trucks, food/market access and storm damage; examined against earlier Nov 20 ledgers, no fresh distinct change.
Latest-news index reviewed; Gaza-specific Bureij and Deir al-Balah items from Nov 20 had already been recorded. Later articles dealt mainly with West Bank incidents or advocacy.

Seven killed and at least thirteen injured in overlapping Nov 20 incidents: four Bureij, two Deir al-Balah, one Nuseirat, plus Maghazi and Sabra injuries and Shuja'iyya/Khan Younis demolitions. No verified additional distinct impact after prior watch.
About 6,000 displaced around Nuseirat/Bureij as part of Nov 18 ground operation, already reported Nov 19 and not a fresh within-window event.
Nov 18 operation corroborated retrospectively, not a new Nov 20 incident.
Nov 20 noon briefing appeared in search, direct fetch gave HTTP 403, so no unsupported detail was extracted.

excluded_candidates: Bureij four fatalities, Deir al-Balah two-versus-one casualty discrepancy, Nuseirat killing and displaced-tent injuries, Maghazi and Sabra injuries, Shuja'iyya and Khan Younis demolitions already logged in earlier Nov 20 watch heartbeats.
Nov 18 Nuseirat/Bureij ground operation, closure and reopening of Salah al-Din road and reported ~6,000 people displaced were reported Nov 18–19; no new within-window change.
UN/OCHA Nov 20 release included historical Nov 10–16 humanitarian data; no newly verified delta since predecessor.
Ceasefire and crossing search results either repeated earlier reports, were older 2023–2025 date collisions, or lacked direct corroboration.
Opinion, unverified social material, duplicative headline aggregates, advocacy with no changed operating condition, and West Bank-only events excluded.

access_failures.error: HTTP 403 on direct page fetch; search excerpt available

coverage_limitations: WHO regional page and one UN Secretariat briefing page were unavailable; OCHA OPT, WHO global, WAFA, Anadolu and other sources remained usable.
Article timestamp ambiguity and overlapping casualty aggregates prevent claims of additional fatalities or new within-hour events.
No inspection, editing, publishing, or approval of primary production; this watch does not assert that production has or has not collected any event.
